title: D2Vita claim decision, v1
description: Body of the 200 response to POST /v1/claims. Like every response to a console endpoint it is signed (X-D2V-Signature). The $defs also describe the other console upload messages: ArtifactStored (201 response to PUT /v1/reports/{report_id}/artifacts/{name}), CompleteRequest and CompleteResponse (POST /v1/reports/{report_id}/complete). Replaying a claim with the same report_id returns the same decision.

upload.description: An UploadGrant when action is upload, null when action is count_only.

retry_after_s.description: When not null, the console sends no other claim before now + retry_after_s.

disable_until_unix.description: When not null, the console sends no other claim before this Unix time.

SignatureId.description: "S" followed by the first 15 characters of the RFC 4648 base32 encoding (uppercase, no padding) of SHA-256(canon). See contract/signature-rules.v1.md.

UploadToken.description: Opaque token, sent back verbatim in "Authorization: D2V-Upload <token>".

artifacts.description: Artifacts the API wants, each at most once.

ArtifactRequest.description: max_bytes is the largest sealed size (Content-Length) the PUT accepts for this artifact.

ArtifactStored.description: Body of the 201 response to PUT /v1/reports/{report_id}/artifacts/{name}. bytes is the stored sealed size.

CompleteRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/reports/{report_id}/complete: names of the artifacts the console uploaded.

CompleteResponse.description: Body of the 200 response to POST /v1/reports/{report_id}/complete.
